summary: KNOREX Ltd., a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a NYSE American notice of non-compliance for failing to file its annual Form 20-F for FY2025 by the extended deadline of May 15, 2026. The NYSE American has provided up to a six-month Initial Cure Period through November 15, 2026, with a possible Additional Cure Period through May 15, 2027, at the Exchange's discretion. If the filing is not cured, suspension and delisting procedures will commence. The Company is working with advisors to file the 2025 Form 20-F but cannot assure regaining compliance. The stock continues trading during the cure period. This filing maps to a US equivalent of a late filing notice triggering potential delisting. Watch for the next filing date and any further NYSE American actions.
